newsitem.title: MOROCCO: First poll results show "yes" to Moroccan reforms.
newsitem.headline: First poll results show "yes" to Moroccan reforms.

text.p: First results from a referendum on Friday showed an overwhelming "yes" vote for constitutional reform which would give Morocco a powerful new upper house of parliament to strengthen regional representation.
The interior ministry said provisional first figures showed a turnout of 81.9 percent. Of the first votes counted, 1.9 million Moroccans had voted "yes" and 4,133 had voted "no".

Results from 10 of the 65 voting areas, in which more than 12 million Moroccans were eligible to vote, showed a "yes" vote ranging from 98.25 percent in Mohammedia, near Casablanca, to 100 percent in Sale, the twin city of the capital Rabat, according to figures given by the official news agency MAP.
